C02 is nearest at 3.118200 dB and is within its 3.623526 dB threshold, so the outcome is similar and the best matching condition is C02 (healthy). C04 is the strongest visual alternative because of the 50 Hz line, similar RMS, shared 0.2494 ms lag, and persistent ~16 kHz ridge, but its 6.351741 dB distance exceeds its 2.463183 dB threshold; the upward shift and stronger top-band concentration in Q01 distinguish it. All reports have identical 10 s duration, 44.1 kHz sampling, physical frequency coverage to 22.05 kHz, and stated resolutions, so no resampling or coverage mismatch explains the decision. Absolute FS levels are interpreted cautiously because acquisition gain is unknown and the files are peak-normalized.
